attribution.note: Marcus's own words in his Substack post, given as his view and not quoted from anyone else.

semantics.note: 'Will build a lot' is a firm forecast. The excess part keeps its 'quite possibly' hedge, so it is not scored. The horizon 'next few years' is kept.

contract.note: Reading 'next few years' as roughly 3 to 5 years, ending by 2030, is an ordinary reading. Scoring only the firm buildout part and leaving out the hedged excess part is fair to his words.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast that both countries will build a lot of AI infrastructure over the next few years. The horizon runs to as late as 2030, after the 2026-10-28 evaluation date. No early-resolution event is documented, and the evidence packet is empty. The forecast cannot be scored yet.
